name: Bottom Taper

side.label: Tape the end facing
side.desc: Bottom tapes the end of the case that stands on the belt, with a head under the line. Top tapes the end that faces up, from a head over it.

standHeight.label: Stand height (m)
standHeight.desc: Height of the conveying surface. The stand runs from the head down to the floor.

showBeam.label: Show beam
showBeam.desc: Draw the eye at the head.

enableComms.label: Enable comms
enableComms.desc: Connect this taper to a PLC program. Its tag appears once this is on.

countTag.label: Cases taped tag
countTag.desc: How many ends this taper has taped since the run started.
